infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Orange Chauffeur requires precise location access to navigate to passenger pickup bays and calculate trip distances.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Orange Chauffeur broadcasts real-time GPS coordinates while on active duty for passenger safety and fleet dispatch.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Orange Chauffeur requires camera access to capture portrait photos and commercial driving licence documents for KYC onboarding.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Orange Chauffeur requires photo library access to upload commercial driving licence and vehicle documents for account verification.
